summary: Turns the search page into a client component that reads q from the URL, fetches matching products and lists them. The change also removes the search form.

findings.title: URL query rendered as raw HTML
findings.problem: The heading inserts the q value from the URL into dangerouslySetInnerHTML without escaping or sanitizing it.
findings.consequence: An attacker can send a crafted search link that runs script in the victim's session. This is reflected XSS.
findings.fix: Render the query as a normal JSX text child so that React escapes it.

findings.title: Effect refetches on every render
findings.problem: The useEffect has no dependency array, so it runs after every render. Each fetch calls setResults with a new array, which triggers another render.
findings.consequence: The page sends search requests to the catalog API in an endless loop while it stays open.
findings.fix: Pass [query] as the dependency array so that the effect runs only when the query changes.

findings.title: Hooks called after a conditional return
findings.problem: The early return for an empty query runs before useState and useEffect. The number of hooks therefore changes between renders.
findings.consequence: React throws a rendered-more-hooks error when q changes from empty to set on client navigation. The page then crashes.
findings.fix: Call useState and useEffect before any early return. Inside the effect, skip the fetch when query is empty.

findings.title: Search form removed with no replacement
findings.problem: The change deletes the only form that submits q to /search. The page now says to type a search term but has no input.
findings.consequence: Users who open /search without q cannot start a search. No other page links to search.
findings.fix: Keep the form with the q input and render it above the results.

findings.title: Search failure becomes an unhandled rejection
findings.problem: searchProducts throws when the response is not ok. The effect chains only then, with no catch.
findings.consequence: A failed search produces an unhandled promise rejection. Users see stale or empty results and get no error message.
findings.fix: Add a catch that records an error state and renders a message for the user.

findings.title: List items rendered without a key
findings.problem: Each li that the results map renders has no key, although Product has a stable id field.
findings.consequence: React logs a key warning and cannot match items when the results change between searches.
findings.fix: Set key to product.id on each li.

findings.title: New search behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The page now fetches products and renders results, but no test exercises this behaviour. The repository contains no test files.
findings.consequence: Regressions in the empty-query, fetch and rendering paths will reach users unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a component test that covers an empty query, a successful search and a failed search.
